Recently, In an analyst report sent to investors and clients on 15 May, General Motors (NYSE:GM) shares have had their Overweight Rating maintained by research analysts at Piper Jaffray, who currently has a $57 TP on company. This target by Piper Jaffray would indicate the possibile upside of 54.30 % from the previous close. General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) Ratings Coverage
Among 11 analysts covering General Motors ( NYSE:GM ), 9 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 82% are positive. General Motors has $70.0 highest and $42.0 lowest target. $52.60’s average target is 42.39% above currents $36.94 stock price. General Motors had 16 analyst reports since November 20, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. Bank of America maintained it with “Buy” rating and $60 target in Wednesday, February 7 report. The company was maintained on Tuesday, January 16 by CFRA. The company was maintained on Monday, February 12 by Citigroup. The firm has “Hold” rating by BMO Capital Markets given on Sunday, March 4. Piper Jaffray maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, February 6 report. The rating was maintained by Nomura with “Neutral” on Thursday, February 8. As per Monday, April 9, the company rating was upgraded by Morgan Stanley. The company was maintained on Wednesday, February 14 by Morgan Stanley. The firm has “Buy” rating by Guggenheim given on Wednesday, February 7. On Tuesday, December 19 the stock rating was upgraded by RBC Capital Markets to “Outperform”.
The stock increased 0.85% or $0.31 $36.94. About 6.50 million shares traded. General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) has risen 0.46% uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.09% the S&P500.
Analysts await General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) to report earnings on July, 24. They expect $1.82 EPS, down 3.70 % or $0.07 from last year’s $1.89 per share. GM’s profit will be $2.57 billion for 5.07 P/E if the $1.82 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.43 actual EPS reported by General Motors Company for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 27.27 % EPS growth.
General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells cars, trucks, crossovers, and automobile parts worldwide. The company has market cap of $52.07 billion. The firm operates through GM North America, GM Europe, GM International Operations, GM South America, and GM Financial divisions. It currently has negative earnings. It markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Holden, Opel, Vauxhall, Baojun, Jiefang, and Wuling brand names.
